title: Stranded Transcript Count Table Generation from Long Reads
author: David A Eccles

steps.title: Demultiplex and Orient Reads
steps.instruction: Demultiplex and orient reads following the 'Preparing Reads for Stranded Mapping' protocol. Ensure demultiplexed reads are in the current directory and accompanied by a 'barcode_counts.txt' file.

substeps.instruction: Verify the presence of oriented read files using the command: for bc in $(awk '{print $2}' barcode_counts.txt); do ls oriented/${bc}_reads_dirAdjusted.fq.gz; done

steps.title: Prepare Transcript Index
steps.instruction: Modify the GENCODE transcript file and mask homopolymers to create a transcript index.

substeps.instruction: Modify the GENCODE transcript file so the Transcript id is the first value: perl -pe 's/>(.*?)\|/>$1 /' gencode.vM28.transcripts.fa > trName_gencode.vM28.transcripts.fa
Mask A or T homopolymers (9 or more) with Ns: fasta_formatter -i trName_gencode.vM28.transcripts.fa | perl -pe 's/(A{9}A+|T{9}T+)/"N" x length($1)/eg' > ATmasked_trName_gencode.vM28.transcripts.fa
Create a shell variable for the file location: indexLoc=$(readlink -e ATmasked_trName_gencode.vM28.transcripts.fa)
Generate the index using LAST (v1409+) with the -uRY4 seeding scheme: lastdb -uRY4 -R01 ${indexLoc} ${indexLoc}

steps.title: Generate Substitution and Variant Matrices
steps.instruction: Prepare a custom substitution matrix (cDNA.mat) and a variant matrix for transcript mapping.

substeps.instruction: Create the cDNA.mat substitution matrix with the following parameters: #last -Q 1, #last -t4.27969, #last -a 15, #last -A 17, #last -b 3, #last -B 4, #last -S 1, and the specified A C G T score matrix.
Generate the variant matrix using last-train on a read file (basecalled with guppy v5.1.15): last-train -Q 1 ${indexLoc} <(zcat oriented/BCXX_reads_dirAdjusted.fq.gz | head -n 100000)

steps.title: Map Reads to Transcriptome
steps.instruction: Map reads to the transcriptome using LAST and filter the results to produce a space-separated file of transcript, read, and direction.

substeps.instruction: Create a directory for output: mkdir -p mapped
Run the mapping loop for each barcode: lastal -P 10 -p cDNA.mat --split-m=0.99 ${indexLoc} mapped/trnMapping_LAST_${bc}_vs_Mmus_transcriptome.csv.gz
Filter results to exclude 100% matches and mappings shorter than 50% of the read where the query mapping proportion is less than the target proportion.

Convert the CSV output to a space-separated format retaining only transcript, read, and direction: zcat mapped/trnMapping_LAST_${bc}_vs_Mmus_transcriptome.csv.gz | awk -F ',' -v 'OFS=\t' '{print $2, $1, $3}' | sort -r | uniq | gzip > mapped/trnMapping_LAST_${bc}_vs_Mmus_transcriptome.txt.gz

steps.title: Aggregate Transcript Counts
steps.instruction: Sum the counts per transcript/direction pair for each barcode.

substeps.instruction: Run the aggregation loop: zcat mapped/trnMapping_${mapper}_${bc}_vs_Mmus_transcriptome.txt.gz | awk -F'\t' -v "bc=${bc}" '{print bc,$1,$3}' | sort | uniq -c | gzip > mapped/trnCounts_${mapper}_${bc}_vs_Mmus_transcriptome.txt.gz
Optional: Calculate the total number of mapped transcripts per barcode: zcat mapped/trnMapping_${mapper}_${bc}_vs_Mmus_transcriptome.txt.gz | awk '{print $2}' | sort | uniq | wc -l

steps.title: Generate Wide Format Count Table
steps.instruction: Merge transcript counts with Ensembl gene annotation and convert to a wide format CSV using an R script.

substeps.instruction: Load barcode identifiers and transcript counts using tidyverse.
Remove revision numbers from transcript names.
Perform an inner join with Ensembl metadata (ensembl.df) by 'transcript'.
Order the results by row sums (descending) and write to 'wide_transcript_counts_LAST.csv'.
